description: This file defines a React component 'ControlDevicesTab' that manages the display, creation, and editing of control device mappings related to an asset. It interacts with backend APIs to fetch control device mappings and master control device data, and provides a UI modal for creating/updating mappings.

methods.name: buildDeviceIndex
methods.description: Creates a Map from controlDeviceId to ControlDeviceMasterDto for quick lookup.

methods.name: reload
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of control device mappings.

methods.name: openCreate
methods.description: Prepares the form for creating a new control device mapping and opens the modal.

methods.name: openEdit
methods.description: Prepares the form with existing data for editing a control device mapping and opens the modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Validates form data, then creates or updates a control device mapping via API, handles errors, and refreshes the list.
